items.why: Nvidia sank in the sell-off after hot CPI data raised rate-hike fears and pushed the 10-year yield toward 5 percent.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Hot CPI data pushed the 10-year yield toward 5 percent as rate-hike bets rose.
Microsoft dropped after reports of an Anthropic threat to Office.

market_note: S&P and Nasdaq futures both down; the 10-year yield is up near 5% on the hot CPI print.
summary: Stocks slipped after hot CPI data raised rate-hike fears, with Nvidia leading tech lower while Microsoft fell on an Anthropic threat to Office.
